data.name: The Watch Log: First Page
data.description:
This weekend's orders: 5 to claim, a Skyglass Token for all five.

The salvager has dried a page of the Ghost Ship's watch log and weighted it under a stone for you. It is one watch's orders, in the officer's brush. Your name is written in at the top, in the same ink.

Walk the tideline where she lies.
Stand two low watches: the breach the low tide opens, and the night roster with your name on it.
Follow one of the crew's own charts below the waterline: what they buried, the works, the archive or the helm.
Go down where the Core could not hold them: to the reliquary, or to the night she fell.
Carry the last light home.

This weekend's orders, in any order:
1. Go to the Skyglass Wreck (sector 210).
2. Win the Low Tide Run or the Night Watch, 2 times in total.
3. Win one of these runs once: The Buried Cache, The Drowned Foundry, The Quarantined Archive or The Captain's Watch.
4. Win one of these runs once: The Sealed Reliquary, The Fall, The Rotted Reliquary or The Burning Heading.
5. Win Crownhold once (its way in is a Lastlight Lantern).

Orders count only while you carry this page: nothing you did before taking it counts. Claim each order's reward in the Logbook when it is done, and finish all 5 for the page's last reward, a Skyglass Token. The page closes at the end of Monday (00:00 UTC Tuesday), so claim before then. Claiming the last order completes the page.
data.successDescription: Page complete. Every order is answered, and the salvager folds the page into her coat with the others. "The next tide brings the next page."

objectives.description:
Walk the tideline where she lies. The page's first order is only to look at her.

Go to the Skyglass Wreck (sector 210). Reward when you claim it: a Tide Chart.
objectives.successDescription: You stand in her shadow. The crew on deck do not look down.

objectives.description:
Stand two low watches: the breach the low tide opens, and the night roster with your name on it.

Win the Low Tide Run or the Night Watch, 2 times in total. Reward when you claim it: a Medicine Inro.
objectives.successDescription: Two watches stood. The roster has a mark beside your name.

objectives.description:
Follow one of the crew's own charts below the waterline: what they buried, the works, the archive or the helm.

Win one of these runs once: The Buried Cache, The Drowned Foundry, The Quarantined Archive or The Captain's Watch. Reward when you claim it: an Archive Chart Case.
objectives.successDescription: The chart led where it said it would. Not every chart aboard her does.

objectives.description:
Go down where the Core could not hold them: to the reliquary, or to the night she fell.

Win one of these runs once: The Sealed Reliquary, The Fall, The Rotted Reliquary or The Burning Heading. Reward when you claim it: a Skyglass Coffer.
objectives.successDescription: You have seen what the Core kept, and what it could not.

objectives.description:
Carry the last light home. The lantern still points the way to Crownhold.

Win Crownhold once (its way in is a Lastlight Lantern). Reward when you claim it: a Sealed Treasury.
objectives.successDescription: Crownhold's signal goes dark behind you. Somewhere below the throne, glass rings once.
